# f5xc_ike_phase1_profile (Data Source)

IKE Phase1 profile mainly includes the following<br>1. Encryption protocols to be used for IKE SA<br>2. Authentication Protocols to be used for IKE SA<br>3. DH group<br>4. PRF<br>5. Key lifetime etc

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Ike Phase1 Profile - Full

data "f5xc_ike_phase1_profile" "example" {
  name      = f5xc_ike_phase1_profile.example.name
  namespace = f5xc_ike_phase1_profile.example.namespace
}
```

- `prf` (List of String) PseudoRandomFunction Select PseudoRandomFunction for IKE SA.
